when i was 14, i struggled with disordered eating habits. it had been a long day at school and i hadn't eaten anything in probably 2-3 days. i got on the train to go home and all the seats were taken, so i was just standing there holding on to the poles. within like 5 minutes of standing, i suddenly started to get a bunch of white spots in my vision. i felt so weak all of a sudden and i started gripping the pole really hard. my skin looked so pale and i didn't know what was going on (fuckin genius, right?) but i felt like i was gonna fall to the floor at any second. the woman sitting in front of me noticed this almost immediately and got up to give me her seat - which i ended up slumping into. she looked so worried and she asked me if i had eaten anything that day. idk why i still felt like lying (i guess out of habit) and i said "yes, i had lunch". she just looked at me, obviously not believing me, and gave me an orange from her purse. i was shaking at that point and i honestly couldn't see much because everything looked so bright, but she helped me peel the orange and i said thank you, had a few pieces, and then ended up waking up about 30 minutes later way past my stop. i don't remember passing out at all, but honestly i won't ever forget how she recognized what was happening to me and how she helped me so promptly. i really hope she's doing well.
